literal: Both clear and resonant, subtly matching the true body.
idiomatic: Clear and resonant—subtly true to the root pitch.

literal: Yet the eight tones' level and muddy qualities—what are they worth praising?"
idiomatic: Yet what merit is there in the eight tones' level and muddy notes?"

literal: Shaoyuan said: "Heaven is the yang position; therefore its tone is level yet muddy—muddy tone is the sovereign's voice.
idiomatic: Changsun Shaoyuan said: "Heaven holds the yang position, so its tone is level yet muddy; muddy tone is the sovereign's voice.

literal: Earth is the yin position; therefore its tone is urgent yet clear—clear tone is the minister's mode.
idiomatic: Earth holds the yin position, so its tone is urgent yet clear; clear tone is the minister's mode.

literal: Yet what is urgent and clear in the body is easily cut off; what is level and muddy in meaning can endure.
idiomatic: Urgent clarity breaks off easily in the body; level mud endures in meaning.

literal: What can endure and grow great is the foundation of kingship.
idiomatic: Endurance and greatness are the king's foundation.

literal: As for the new sounds of Zheng and Wei—they are not without clear resonance; yet if one wished to apply them in a sage age, I would not take them.
idiomatic: The new sounds of Zheng and Wei are not without clear tone—but to set them in a sage age, I would not take them.

literal: " Thereupon it was settled to take eight as the number.
idiomatic: " Thereupon it was fixed: eight would be the number.

literal: Soon after he was appointed Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao, then served as Junior Guardian, Junior Minister of Works, and went out as Inspector of Hezhou.
idiomatic: Soon he was made Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao, then Junior Guardian and Junior Minister of Works, and went out as Inspector of Hezhou.

literal: On the right bank of the Yellow River the tribal settlements were daily drawing nearer to civilization; and marriage within the same surname had become custom.
idiomatic: On the river's right bank the tribes drew daily toward civilization; marriage within the same surname had become custom.

literal: Shaoyuan guided them with ritual and greatly reformed corrupt ways.
idiomatic: Shaoyuan led them with ritual and greatly reformed corrupt custom.

literal: His government was simple and forgiving; the people submitted gladly.
idiomatic: His rule was spare and forgiving; the people gladly obeyed.

literal: He entered the capital as Junior Director of the Imperial Clan.
idiomatic: He entered the capital as Junior Director of the Imperial Clan.

literal: Emperor Wu was reading histories and saw that when King Wu of Zhou conquered Yin he made the seven beginnings; he also wished to abolish the eight suspended sets and use seven, and to remove the Yellow Bell as the correct palace tone and make Forest Bell the tuning head.
idiomatic: Emperor Wu was reading histories and saw that when King Wu of Zhou conquered Yin he fashioned the seven beginnings; he also wished to abolish the eight suspended sets for seven, remove the Yellow Bell as the correct palace tone, and make Forest Bell the tuning head.

literal: Shaoyuan memorialized: "The Son of Heaven suspends eight—hundred kings share this track.
idiomatic: Shaoyuan memorialized: "The Son of Heaven suspends eight sets—hundred kings share this track.

literal: Down to Zhou Wu, he had only just perfected the music of the seven beginnings.
idiomatic: Down to Zhou Wu, he had only just perfected the music of the seven beginnings.

literal: Examining the classics in detail, there is no canon for abolishing eight.
idiomatic: Examining the classics in detail, there is no canon for abolishing eight.

literal: Moreover the Yellow Bell is sovereign; it is the Son of Heaven's correct position—now to wish to abolish it, I do not see how it can be done.
idiomatic: Moreover the Yellow Bell is sovereign—the Son of Heaven's correct position; to abolish it now, I do not see how it can be done.

literal: Your servant finds in the Rites of Zhou: "Play the Yellow Bell, sing the Great Lü"—this is the great model of the former sages, clear proof that cannot be changed.
idiomatic: Your servant finds in the Rites of Zhou: "Play the Yellow Bell, sing the Great Lü"—the former sages' great model, proof that cannot be changed.

literal: I beg that you not lightly alter the ancient canon or hasten to change the music chapters.
idiomatic: I beg that you not lightly alter the ancient canon or hasten to change the music chapters.

literal: " The emperor was silent a long while and said: "My wish to abolish eight and suspend seven is that I seek the root of the body and pursue what is straight—not to change names carelessly.
idiomatic: " The emperor was silent a long while and said: "My wish to abolish eight for seven is to seek the root of the body and pursue what is straight—not to change names carelessly.

literal: I shall think further on its meaning.
idiomatic: I shall think further on its meaning.

literal: " Later he still carried out the seven tones.
idiomatic: " Later he still carried out the seven tones.

literal: It happened that Shaoyuan fell ill and could not present his views in person.
idiomatic: It happened that Shaoyuan fell ill and could not present his views in person.

literal: Fearing that the offices would hastily discard the instruments, he wrote to Qi Shu of the Music Bureau: "I have heard that the court lately debated abolishing eight and suspending seven.
idiomatic: Fearing the offices would hastily discard the instruments, he wrote to Qi Shu of the Music Bureau: "I have heard the court lately debated abolishing eight for seven.

literal: Yet the Son of Heaven's suspension of eight has been so from antiquity.
idiomatic: Yet the Son of Heaven's suspension of eight has been so from antiquity.

literal: The ancient sages, though their paths differed, agreed in one;
idiomatic: The ancient sages, though their paths differed, agreed in one;

literal: down to Zhou Wu's conquest of Yin, he took by reversal and kept by compliance, using arms alone—affairs contrary to yielding by courtesy.
idiomatic: down to Zhou Wu's conquest of Yin, he took by reversal and kept by compliance, using arms alone—affairs contrary to yielding by courtesy.

literal: Turning back to seek the classics' meaning, he used the seven tones—hardly a canon unchanging for ten thousand generations.
idiomatic: Turning back to seek the classics' meaning, he used the seven tones—hardly a canon unchanging for ten thousand generations.

literal: The eight suspended sets of bells and stands must not be destroyed.
idiomatic: The eight suspended sets of bells and stands must not be destroyed.

literal: Wait until my illness clears; I shall memorialize separately.
idiomatic: Wait until my illness clears; I shall memorialize separately.

literal: " After this Shaoyuan's illness grew grave; he charged his son Lan: "The Yellow Bell is the Son of Heaven's palace.
idiomatic: " After this Shaoyuan's illness grew grave; he charged his son Lan: "The Yellow Bell is the Son of Heaven's palace.

literal: The Great Lü is the empress's position.
idiomatic: The Great Lü is the empress's position.

literal: Now to abolish the Yellow Bell's position is to strip salary from the royal house.
idiomatic: Now to abolish the Yellow Bell's position is to strip salary from the royal house.

literal: If Forest Bell is made head, government issues from private gates.
idiomatic: If Forest Bell is made head, government issues from private gates.

literal: I fear the eight-hundred-year fortune may not match the Zhou's eternity.
idiomatic: I fear the eight-hundred-year fortune may not match the Zhou's eternity.

literal: I have been a minister; in duty I cannot lie silent—I shall surely be carried in my illness to contend at the palace gate.
idiomatic: I have been a minister; in duty I cannot lie silent—I shall surely be carried in my illness to contend at the palace gate.

literal: " When his illness grew worse he submitted a final memorial: "Your servant respectfully finds in the Spring and Autumn, Duke Yin's Tradition: 'The Son of Heaven uses eight.'
idiomatic: " When his illness grew worse he submitted a final memorial: "Your servant respectfully finds in the Spring and Autumn, Duke Yin's Tradition: 'The Son of Heaven uses eight.'

literal: The Rites of Zhou say the Son of Heaven suspends two eights; the Zhui clan's bells number sixteen, the Mugou clan's chime-stones sixteen.
idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou say the Son of Heaven suspends two eights; the Zhui clan's bells number sixteen, the Mugou clan's chime-stones sixteen.

literal: Emperor Cheng of Han obtained ancient chime-stones numbering sixteen.
idiomatic: Emperor Cheng of Han obtained ancient chime-stones numbering sixteen.

literal: The Diagram of the Rites of Zhou shows sixteen suspended.
idiomatic: The Diagram of the Rites of Zhou shows sixteen suspended.

literal: These several matters illuminate the canons.
idiomatic: These several matters illuminate the canons.

literal: Weighing them and speaking, they suffice as a tortoise mirror.
idiomatic: Weighing them and speaking, they suffice as a tortoise mirror.

literal: Your servant considers that Your Majesty received the chart from the Blue Emperor and succeeded to the Dark Essence; since Qin and Han, you alone are foremost in renown.
idiomatic: Your servant considers that Your Majesty received the chart from the Blue Emperor and succeeded to the Dark Essence; since Qin and Han, you alone are foremost in renown.

literal: As for Zhou Wu, he had recourse to arms—I alone despise him; how much more Your Majesty.
idiomatic: As for Zhou Wu, he had recourse to arms—I alone despise him; how much more Your Majesty.

literal: Measuring my remaining breath, it is not evening but morning.
idiomatic: Measuring my remaining breath, it is not evening but morning.

literal: I humbly beg that you treasure the myriad affairs and not trouble to change eight to seven.
idiomatic: I humbly beg that you treasure the myriad affairs and not trouble to change eight to seven.

literal: " When the emperor read the memorial he wept; he posthumously enfeoffed him Grand General of the Pillar of State, posthumous name Xian, title Ancestor of Music, with matching sacrifice in the temple court.
idiomatic: " When the emperor read the memorial he wept; he posthumously enfeoffed him Grand General of the Pillar of State, posthumous name Xian, title Ancestor of Music, with matching sacrifice in the temple court.

literal: His son Lan succeeded.
idiomatic: His son Lan succeeded.

literal: Shaoyuan's son Lan
idiomatic: Changsun Shaoyuan's son Lan

literal: Lan, styled Xiuyin, was by nature magnanimous and refined, with bearing and capacity; joy and anger did not show on his face.
idiomatic: Lan, styled Xiuyin, was by nature magnanimous and refined, with bearing and capacity; joy and anger did not show on his face.

literal: He had slight acquaintance with documents and was especially versed in pitch pipes and scales.
idiomatic: He had slight acquaintance with documents and was especially versed in pitch pipes and scales.

literal: Under Emperor Ming of Zhou he was Grand Commander.
idiomatic: Under Emperor Ming of Zhou he was Grand Commander.

literal: Mingdi, because Lan's nature was pure and harmonious and fit to be a teacher's model, had him attend the Duke of Lu and showed him great favor.
idiomatic: Mingdi, because Lan's nature was pure and harmonious and fit to be a teacher's model, had him attend the Duke of Lu and showed him great favor.

literal: When the Duke of Lu took the throne as Emperor Wu, Lan was promoted in one step to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
idiomatic: When the Duke of Lu took the throne as Emperor Wu, Lan was promoted in one step to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

literal: Whenever the high ministers submitted memorials, the emperor always had Lan review and read them.
idiomatic: Whenever the high ministers submitted memorials, the emperor always had Lan review and read them.

literal: Lan had eloquence; his voice was strong and resonant; whatever he announced, the hundred officials fixed their eyes on him.
idiomatic: Lan had eloquence; his voice was strong and resonant; whatever he announced, the hundred officials fixed their eyes on him.

literal: The emperor often praised him in admiration.
idiomatic: The emperor often praised him in admiration.

literal: Lan's original name was Shan; the emperor said to him: "I entrust the myriad affairs to you for prior review.
idiomatic: Lan's original name was Shan; the emperor said to him: "I entrust the myriad affairs to you for prior review.

literal: " Thereupon he was granted the name Lan.
idiomatic: " Thereupon he was granted the name Lan.

literal: When Yuwen Hu was executed, for merit he was advanced to Duke of Xue and successively made Junior Minister of Works.
idiomatic: When Yuwen Hu was executed, for merit he was advanced to Duke of Xue and successively made Junior Minister of Works.

literal: He followed in the pacification of Qi and was advanced to Pillar of State.
idiomatic: He followed in the pacification of Qi and was advanced to Pillar of State.

literal: When Emperor Wu died, he received the testament and assisted in government.
idiomatic: When Emperor Wu died, he received the testament and assisted in government.

literal: Under Emperor Xuan he was Senior Pillar of State and Grand Minister of Education, and served as Inspector of Tong and Jing provinces.
idiomatic: Under Emperor Xuan he was Senior Pillar of State and Grand Minister of Education, and served as Inspector of Tong and Jing provinces.

literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui was Chancellor, Lan was transferred to Inspector of Yi Province.
idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui was Chancellor, Lan was transferred to Inspector of Yi Province.

literal: In the second year of Kaihuang, when there was to be an expedition against the south, he was summoned as Commander-in-Chief of the Southeast Route Army, commanding eight supreme commanders out of Shouyang, advancing by land and water together.
idiomatic: In the second year of Kaihuang, when there was to be an expedition against the south, he was summoned as Commander-in-Chief of the Southeast Route Army, commanding eight supreme commanders out of Shouyang, advancing by land and water together.

literal: When the army reached the Yangzi, the Chen people were greatly alarmed.
idiomatic: When the army reached the Yangzi, the Chen people were greatly alarmed.

literal: It happened that Emperor Xuan of Chen died; Lan wished to seize the chance and destroy them, but the supervising general Gao Jiong, citing the rite of not attacking during mourning, turned back.
idiomatic: It happened that Emperor Xuan of Chen died; Lan wished to seize the chance and destroy them, but the supervising general Gao Jiong, citing the rite of not attacking during mourning, turned back.

literal: Emperor Wen ordered Lan to feast together with Prince Andre Yang Xiong, Senior Pillar of State Yuan Xie, Li Chong, Left Vice Director Gao Jiong, Right Guards General Yu Qingze, Wu Prefecture Supreme Commander He Ruo Bi, and others.
idiomatic: Emperor Wen ordered Lan to feast together with Prince Andre Yang Xiong, Senior Pillar of State Yuan Xie, Li Chong, Left Vice Director Gao Jiong, Right Guards General Yu Qingze, Wu Prefecture Supreme Commander He Ruo Bi, and others.

literal: The emperor said: "In former days in the Zhou court I fully showed my loyalty.
idiomatic: The emperor said: "In former days in the Zhou court I fully showed my loyalty.

literal: But I suffered from suspicion and was constantly chilled at heart.
idiomatic: But I suffered from suspicion and was constantly chilled at heart.

literal: To be a minister like this—what affection can one rely on!
idiomatic: To be a minister like this—what affection can one rely on!

literal: I and you gentlemen shall share a fortunate end together.
idiomatic: I and you gentlemen shall share a fortunate end together.

literal: Crimes that are not treasonous plots—nothing will be asked.
idiomatic: Crimes that are not treasonous plots—nothing will be asked.

literal: I also know that you are utterly loyal in serving the crown prince; you should often go to see him.
idiomatic: I also know that you are utterly loyal in serving the crown prince; you should often go to see him.

literal: The pillar minister's long-standing repute truly belongs to you.
idiomatic: The pillar minister's long-standing repute truly belongs to you.

literal: You should understand my intent.
idiomatic: You should understand my intent.

literal: " His favor and ritual were like this.
idiomatic: " His favor and ritual were like this.

literal: He also had Prince Xiu of Shu take Lan's daughter as consort.
idiomatic: He also had Prince Xiu of Shu take Lan's daughter as consort.

literal: Later he was Inspector of Jing Province.
idiomatic: Later he was Inspector of Jing Province.

literal: He died in office.
idiomatic: He died in office.

literal: His son Hong succeeded, holding the posts of Inspector of Song, Shun, and Lin provinces, Vice Minister of Agriculture, and Governor of Beiping.
idiomatic: His son Hong succeeded, holding the posts of Inspector of Song, Shun, and Lin provinces, Vice Minister of Agriculture, and Governor of Beiping.

literal: Shaoyuan's younger brother Cheng
idiomatic: Shaoyuan's younger brother Cheng

literal: Cheng, styled Shiliang, at age ten was seen by Minister of Education Li Yanzhi and considered extraordinary; he gave him his daughter in marriage.
idiomatic: Cheng, styled Shiliang, at age ten was seen by Minister of Education Li Yanzhi and considered extraordinary; he gave him his daughter in marriage.

literal: At fourteen he followed his father Chengye on campaign; he had stratagems and his courage topped the generals.
idiomatic: At fourteen he followed his father Chengye on campaign; he had stratagems and his courage topped the generals.

literal: For merit he was enfeoffed Marquis of Xihua county.
idiomatic: For merit he was enfeoffed Marquis of Xihua county.

literal: When grown, his appearance was towering and his bearing warm and refined.
idiomatic: When grown, his appearance was towering and his bearing warm and refined.

literal: In the Great Unity era of Wei he successively held the posts of Inspector of Yu and Wei provinces.
idiomatic: In the Great Unity era of Wei he successively held the posts of Inspector of Yu and Wei provinces.

literal: For military merit he was separately enfeoffed Baron of Yongning county, then advanced to Marquis of Fujin county.
idiomatic: For military merit he was separately enfeoffed Baron of Yongning county, then advanced to Marquis of Fujin county.

literal: Emperor Wen of Wei, at a banquet with Yuwen Tai and the assembled dukes, said at ease: "The Classic of Filial Piety in one scroll is the root of human conduct; you gentlemen should each cite a key passage from the Classic of Filial Piety.
idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Wei, at a banquet with Yuwen Tai and the assembled dukes, said at ease: "The Classic of Filial Piety in one scroll is the root of human conduct; you gentlemen should each cite a key passage from the Classic of Filial Piety.

literal: " Cheng answered at once: "Rising early and never slackening, to serve one man.
idiomatic: " Cheng answered at once: "Rising early and never slackening, to serve one man.

literal: " Someone in the assembly next said: "Rescue him from his evil.
idiomatic: " Someone in the assembly next said: "Rescue him from his evil.

literal: " After leaving the western pavilion, Yuwen Tai deeply sighed at Cheng's hitting the mark and rebuked the one who answered next.
idiomatic: " After leaving the western pavilion, Yuwen Tai deeply sighed at Cheng's hitting the mark and rebuked the one who answered next.

literal: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou took the throne, Cheng was appointed Grand General and advanced to Duke of Yimen commandery.
idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou took the throne, Cheng was appointed Grand General and advanced to Duke of Yimen commandery.

literal: He went out as Supreme Commander of Yubi and had considerable prestige and authority.
idiomatic: He went out as Supreme Commander of Yubi and had considerable prestige and authority.

literal: He died in his post; posthumously enfeoffed Pillar of State, posthumous name Jian.
idiomatic: He died in his post; posthumously enfeoffed Pillar of State, posthumous name Jian.

literal: From the first of mourning until the burial, Emperor Ming thrice came in person.
idiomatic: From the first of mourning until the burial, Emperor Ming thrice came in person.

literal: Director of Sacrifices Zhongdafu Yuwen Rong remonstrated: "The ruler attending a minister's mourning has its own measure.
idiomatic: Director of Sacrifices Zhongdafu Yuwen Rong remonstrated: "The ruler attending a minister's mourning has its own measure.

literal: Now the imperial carriage has repeatedly descended— I fear it strays from the canon.
idiomatic: Now the imperial carriage has repeatedly descended— I fear it strays from the canon.

literal: " The emperor did not follow him.
idiomatic: " The emperor did not follow him.
